## v1.0

Initial release.

- Chord reference for nine 9-note handpans, showing which pads to strike on a
  diagram of the shell.
- Chords derived at runtime from each drum's tuning rather than hardcoded, so
  every playable chord appears automatically (41 on D Kurd 9).
- Chord depth filter: triads, plus sixths and sevenths, or everything.
- Practice mode with 14 melodic phrases, played back one strike at a time with
  the next pad marked ahead. Includes phrases using the ding as a bass voice
  and two-pad strikes.
- Three practice speeds; step through phrases by hand at your own pace.
- Favorites saved to the SD card.
